text: Bombas' distribution runs through a network of third-party logistics (3PL) partners rather than only company-owned warehouses, per its open VP of Distribution role.

evidence.quote: Lead and govern a network of third-party logistics (3PL) partners, including selection, onboarding, contract negotiation

text: The VP of Distribution is the primary owner of Bombas' 3PL relationships and is expected to spend significant time on site at partner facilities.

evidence.quote: Serve as the primary owner of 3PL relationships, spending significant, regular time on the ground

text: Bombas grew shipment volume through logistics partner Flexport by 605 percent between 2017 and 2021.

evidence.quote: Bombas has increased their shipments with Flexport by 605%

text: Bombas moved a distribution center from New Jersey to California with Flexport's help, cutting ocean shipment transit time nearly in half.

evidence.quote: reducing ocean shipment transit time from 28 to 18 days

text: Bombas' donation supply chain had shipped over 75 million clothing items to people experiencing homelessness, as of 2022, through a network of 3,500 Giving Partner organizations.

evidence.quote: 75 million clothing items donated to people experiencing homelessness in 2022

text: As of October 2025, wholesale accounts including Target, DSW, Dick's Sporting Goods, Nordstrom and Scheels made up less than 10 percent of Bombas' total sales, with Bombas projected near 500 million dollars in 2025 revenue.

evidence.quote: wholesale accounts for less than 10 percent of Bombas' sales
